doc.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: So I think we’re done. Unless there is anything you’d like to add.
So I can retire now, you mean? (laughs)
Anything you want to… any message you want to leave the world?
There’s gotta be something there. Don’t walk in front of a car. I don’t know. (laughs) Ah, just get on with it. (laughs)

Don’t get nailed to the cross too early. (laughs) Yeah, I always picture… if there… I told you if there were a Jesus, he’d say, “Schmuck, what you doing in my name? I don’t mean… Didn’t mean this.” (laughs)
Well, thank you for sitting through this.
You’re, you’re welcome. (laughs) I hope it… Probably the Smithsonian will fold now, right?
Well, Ken didn’t cut me off so I think we probably got what they wanted. END
